productionComparison.source: config/environments.yaml y evidencia histórica versionada; no consulta productiva

args.query:
BEGIN TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY;
SET LOCAL statement_timeout='30s';
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
'clientsWithBookings',(SELECT count(*) FROM public."Client" c WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public."Booking" b WHERE b."clientId"=c.id AND b."organizationId"=c."organizationId")),
'linksWithoutClerk',(SELECT count(*) FROM public."Client" c JOIN public."User" u ON u.id=c."userId" WHERE u."clerkUserId" IS NULL),
'foreignClientBookings',(SELECT count(*) FROM public."Booking" b JOIN public."Client" c ON c.id=b."clientId" WHERE c."organizationId"<>b."organizationId"),
'orphanClients',(SELECT count(*) FROM public."Client" c LEFT JOIN public."Organization" o ON o.id=c."organizationId" LEFT JOIN public."User" u ON u.id=c."userId" WHERE o.id IS NULL OR (c."userId" IS NOT NULL AND u.id IS NULL)),
'organizationsOutsideDocumentedSyntheticSet',(SELECT count(*) FROM public."Organization" WHERE slug NOT IN ('qa-horario-norte','qa-horario-sur','m1-c3-norte','m1-c3-sur')),
'runtimeClientUpdate',has_table_privilege('kortek_runtime','public."Client"','UPDATE'),
'runtimeLedgerSelect',has_table_privilege('kortek_runtime','public."_prisma_migrations"','SELECT'),
'runtimeDatabaseCreate',has_database_privilege('kortek_runtime',current_database(),'CREATE'),
'runtimeSchemaCreate',has_schema_privilege('kortek_runtime','public','CREATE'),
'defaultDmlEntries',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_default_acl a,aclexplode(a.defaclacl) acl WHERE a.defaclrole='kortek_migrator'::regrole AND a.defaclobjtype='r' AND acl.grantee IN (0,'kortek_runtime'::regrole)),
'extensions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',extname,'version',extversion) ORDER BY extname) FROM pg_extension),
'publicBytes',(SELECT coalesce(sum(pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)),0) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relkind IN ('r','p'))
) AS checks;
COMMIT;
